chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
When you give to them, then teach them the du'a, for their du'a for you is answered, while their du'a for themselves is not answered.

key_terms.أَعْطَيْتُمُوهُمْ: you gave to them; meaning you offered them charity or support
key_terms.الدُّعَاءَ: the du'a; supplication made to Allah
key_terms.فَلَقِّنُوهُمُ: then teach or prompt them; meaning encourage them to say a supplication
key_terms.فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ: for themselves; concerning their own personal needs
key_terms.فِيكُمْ: for you; on your behalf or concerning you
key_terms.يُسْتَجَابُ: it is answered; meaning accepted by Allah

ai.seo_question: Why should a person ask the poor to pray for them after giving charity?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teaches that when giving charity to those in need, one should ask them to make du'a. The hadith emphasizes the spiritual value of supporting the needy and indicates that their supplication on behalf of the giver is especially worthy of acceptance.
